name: How long does a typical home addition project take with Frasheski Construction?
description: Home addition timelines vary from 3-6 months for smaller projects to 6-12+ months for larger ones, depending on complexity and permitting.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical home addition project take with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a home addition varies significantly based on its size, complexity, and the local permitting process. A smaller room addition might take 3-6 months from design to completion, while a larger, more complex project like a second-story addition could extend to 6-12 months or more. We provide a detailed project schedule after the design and permitting phases are complete, clarifying expectations for each stage. Securing necessary permits in East Bay cities like Albany or El Cerrito often influences the overall project duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Home addition timelines vary from 3-6 months for smaller projects to 6-12+ months for larger ones, depending on complexity and permitting.
